meta.note: AGGREGATE ONLY — zero PII. Numbers for the investor / B2B-pilot panel. Provenance per block in investor_data.README.md. Every figure is system-recorded unless it sits in `reported` (Liam-supplied) or `phase2_demo` (illustrative).

media.source: Meta Ads Manager, ad account 820757680962871, pulled 2026-09-04

lifetime.note: conversations_started = Meta 'Messaging conversations started (7d)' summed across 11 CTWA campaigns. Two link-click campaigns ($670.37, 14,393 link clicks to a wa.me link) are not attributed by Meta and are excluded from this count.

aligned.note: Same account, windowed to when the CRM pipeline went live (2026-03-01). Use this spend for every cost-per ratio so the numerator and denominator cover the same leads.

unattributed.label: Maduwan waLink tests (link-click ads, no conversation attribution)

media.campaigns_note: Aligned window (2026-03-01 → 2026-09-04). Rows + unattributed = $8,246.59 and 860 conversations exactly. Per-campaign leads count only records carrying a campaign_code (601 of 838), so campaign-level cost per lead is a ceiling.

funnel.source: Firebase /Leads (created ≥ 2026-01-01, n=866; media-origin subset n=838) joined to Postgres inbound messages by contact_id, pulled 2026-09-04

definitions.leads_media_origin: leads_in_crm minus 28 non-media imports created in 2026 (dormant re-activation, manual, reminder-bot backlog). 65 leads recovered from a persistence leak ARE media-origin and stay in. Every engagement figure below is computed on this 838-lead set.
definitions.engaged_1plus: Media-origin lead whose contact sent ≥1 inbound WhatsApp message (Postgres join, not Firebase status). 41 media-origin leads have no contact_id and count as not engaged.
definitions.engaged_2plus: ≥2 inbound messages — replied more than once.
definitions.engaged_5plus: ≥5 inbound messages — in a real conversation.

best_week_reply_rate.note: re-engagement waves to cold leads; WARM tier replied at 83% off the same copy

reported.note: NOT in any system of record. Liam supplies. Rendered as 'awaiting confirmation' while null; cost-per-meeting / cost-per-closing compute only when filled.

track_record.note: All 17 first-contacts predate the 2026 media pilot; none is attributable to pilot spend. This block proves closing ability, not pilot ROI.

pipeline.note: Contract-stage and hot leads. Speculative — never counted as sales.

phase2_demo.note: ILLUSTRATIVE. A worked example of what the closed-loop report looks like once calls, meetings and closings are logged inside the system. Not real data.
